She was also available on the day of delivery, helping me with breathing techniques and the movements. featured_reviews.name: Angel Sweety
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing and concerning culture at The Body Project Gym,
I was just about to join the gym but till then I got to know that a member was reportedly denied membership renewal because he was helping and guiding fellow gym members during workouts. The reason allegedly given was that such guidance was affecting the gym’s personal training business and reducing potential PT clients.

If this is true, it raises serious concerns for every member. And i am a person who is a beginner and obviously I need someone to help me at the start and i cant afford to keep a personal trainer for myself. If I am joining and i then am not allowed to have friends or ask anyone anything then it would be so dumb joining here....A gym should be a place where people support, motivate, and learn from each other. Denying renewal to someone simply because they share fitness knowledge with fellow members creates a toxic and insecure environment. When I enquired most of the people said not to join this GYM because of such behaviour, and i think people go to Gym to socialize themselves rather than isolating.

What is even more worrying is that if this can happen to one member today, it can happen to any member tomorrow. Many experienced gym-goers naturally help beginners with form, technique, or motivation without charging money or claiming to be trainers. Treating such interactions as a business threat reflects poorly on the management’s priorities.

Instead of focusing on member satisfaction, retention, and building a strong fitness community, it appears the emphasis is being placed solely on protecting personal training revenue.

A gym membership is a service paid for by members, not a privilege that can be arbitrarily denied. This incident leaves a very negative impression about the management’s attitude toward its own members.

Arun Sir has a very calming voice, smiling face and always cheerful. He also shares the benefits of how the asanas will help us in a certain health issue. Eg. gas issues or a shoulder pain. It is all in the breath-work he emphasizes.
